scripts.fmt: pnpm run fmt:web && pnpm run fmt:python && pnpm run fmt:rust
scripts.fmt:rust: cargo fmt --manifest-path src/extensions/design/native/Cargo.toml && cargo fmt --manifest-path src/extensions/python/packages/computer-use/Cargo.toml && cargo fmt --manifest-path src/extensions/python/packages/pi-repl-tools/Cargo.toml
scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json && pnpm run typecheck:openui && pnpm --filter @pi-design/react --filter @pi-design/editor run typecheck
scripts.build:design: pnpm --filter @pi-design/react run build && pnpm --filter @pi-design/editor run build
